question_record.context: A security incident was reported where all file snapshots and shadow copies were deleted via WMI or VSSAdmin, which is a common indicator of ransomware infection. The file `vssblatemp.exe` was launched on the host `vnevado-win11t` with the command line `vssblatemp.exe delete shadows /all`. The Process ID was 1900.
question_record.question: Following this incident, numerous file system changes were detected indicating possible ransomware activity. One of the files observed in this context is a PowerShell script. What is the name of this PowerShell script?
solution: All file snapshots and shadow copies were deleted via WMI or VSSAdmin by an account with SID `S-1-5-21-1840191660-8534830288-125585561-1522`, which is common during a ransomware infection.
A possible ransomware activity was detected involving numerous file system changes and appending a known malicious file extension, including the file `get-userprttoken.ps1`.

146.description: Numerous file system changes have been observed on the device. The changes involve appending a file extension that is known and observed in past ransomware incidents. This file system activity might be indicative of mass encryption of files by ransomware.

       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention' AND o.Concept = 'Account_SID'
